title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025

qualification: Currently pursuing a degree in CS or related field; proficiency in C++, Java, or Python.
description: As a Software Engineering Intern, you will work on core products and infrastructure that impact millions of users globally, working alongside industry experts.

title: Chevening Fully Funded UK Government Scholarships
eligibility: Mid-career professionals with at least 2 years of work experience from Chevening-eligible countries.
qualification: Undergraduate degree enabling entry into a UK postgraduate program.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue a fully funded one-year master's degree at any UK university.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with relevant JavaScript and modern framework experience.
qualification: 1+ years experience with JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and frameworks like Vue.js or React.
description: Join GitLab's fully remote engineering team to maintain and build new user interface features for the DevOps platform using Vue.js.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of product management experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
description: Drive product features from concept to launch, collaborate with engineering teams, and define user-centric product strategies across Microsoft products.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide interested in learning computer science and programming fundamentals.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Imagine Cup Global Student Technology Competition

description: Global student technology competition encouraging young innovators to build original tech solutions using Microsoft Azure to solve real-world issues.
